Egypt-United States BIT (in force 1986; Protocol of 1992)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 on Anti-Money Laundering (as amended by Law No. 36 of 2014 and Law No. 154 of 2019); Prime Ministerial Decree No. 2063 of 2017 (Executive Regulations including UBO identification and customer due diligence); Unified Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 (GAFI beneficial-owner filing mandate); Law No. 94 of 2015 on Combatting Terrorism; Central Bank of Egypt AML rules; Financial Regulatory Authority AML rules; Law No. 46 of 1959 on Import/Export Control applicable to dual-use UAV goods

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of residence of each person
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Egypt is not a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; chain: Notary Public -> Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the origin state -> Embassy/Consulate of Egypt)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing and Certificate of Incumbency of each foreign corporate shareholder

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors / corporate secretary of the foreign shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Notary Public -> Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the origin state -> Egyptian Embassy/Consulate)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Notary Public -> Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the origin state -> Egyptian Embassy/Consulate)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced screening of all UBOs, directors, officers and signatories against: OFAC SDN and non-SDN sanctions lists, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated List, UK OFSI list, and Egypt's national terrorist designation list maintained by the AML/CFT Unit and the Central Bank of Egypt. Because ISIC 2821 autonomous agricultural sprayers are dual-use UAV technology, enhanced due diligence (EDD) is mandatory: verified source of funds, documented origin of technical know-how, senior-management approval, and Ministerial pre-clearance evidence are required before incorporation filing.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: GAFI Invest in Egypt e-portal (www.investinegypt.gov.eg and gafi.gov.eg) interconnected with the Ministry of Supply Commercial Registry database; conventional counter clearance available at the Commercial Registry office of Cairo, Giza or the Suez Canal Economic Zone
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be registered in Arabic script and constitutes the legal identity; a parallel Latin-script transliteration is permitted for foreign trade, trademark and banking purposes but carries no independent legal priority. The name must be distinctive, non-misleading as to activity, and must include the LLC form suffix (Shirkat Dhat Mas'uliyya Mahduda). Foreign-origin names are transliterated phonetically into Arabic by the registry.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Tokens implying state sovereignty or patronage: National, Presidential, Ministry, Central, Supreme, Military, Defence, Arab Republic, Islam (in a state-implication context)
Regulated-sector tokens requiring sectoral license: Bank, Insurance, Financial, Securities, Exchange, Currency
UAV-specific tokens: Drone, Unmanned Aerial Vehicle, Autopilot, Aerial System - accepted only upon exhibits of Ministry of Defense and Ministry of Civil Aviation dual-use pre-clearance
Pure arbitrary letter/number strings lacking a distinctive word element; names contrary to public order, religious decency, or that duplicate an existing registered mark
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: On rejection, the registry issues a written reasoned decision; the applicant submits an administrative grievance to the GAFI Complaint and Licensing Committee or the competent Commercial Registry authority within 30 days, attaching alternative proposed names and a legal opinion from Arabic-licensed counsel. If the grievance is refused, appeal to the Administrative Court (State Council) within 60 days of notification. The fastest complementary route is to secure the Defense/Civil Aviation ministerial clearance and re-file a new clearance application; preliminary name availability checks are free and do not toll the statutory window.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for the manufacturing entity. A physical registered seat in Egypt is mandatory, evidenced by a lease or ownership title for the factory/warehouse and administrative office; a virtual or co-working address may serve only as a supplementary correspondence address and cannot satisfy commercial-registry, tax or customs substance requirements.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High - approximately 80% probability of an unannounced physical inspection within the first 12 months. Authorities likely to inspect: Ministry of Interior licensing units, Ministry of Defense export-control inspectors, Egyptian Civil Aviation Authority, Customs/GOEIC, and GAFI, verifying true manufacturing presence, employment, and inventory.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law No. 180 of 2018 issuing the Companies Law; Articles 1-8, 22-31 (LLC formation and management); Commercial Registry Law No. 34 of 1976
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Egyptian General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – Companies Registration Department
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Notarized Articles of Association and incorporation application form (GAFI 'Sharkat' electronic filing portal)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for LLC; capital must be sufficient for corporate purpose, and at least the capital stated in the Articles of Association must be subscribed; cash contributions must be deposited in a temporary escrow bank account held in the LLC's name prior to incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The board of directors resolves: (1) all shares in the share capital as set forth in the Articles of Association are accepted and allotted to the subscribing members; (2) the registered office located at the address provided to the Commercial Registry is adopted; (3) the individuals listed in the application are appointed as managing director, financial officer, and company secretary with full statutory authority; (4) management is authorized to complete the bank account activation and GAFI registration; and (5) this resolution is effective immediately and shall be filed with the registry within the statutory period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Commercial Registry – Trade Name Reservation Window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three proposed Arabic trade names via GAFI's online portal, attaching the legal entity passport and shareholder identification. Pay the name reservation fee. The approved name is reserved for 60 days and must match the English transliteration in the Articles of Association.
required_dossiers: Legal entity passport or identification for corporate shareholders
Original bank receipt of reservation fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If name rejected for similarity or violation of public order, submit revised alternatives within 7 days; administrative appeal may be filed with GAFI's Legal Department without resubmission of all dossiers.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Justice – Notary Public Office; GAFI legal review
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed corporate attorney to draft the Articles of Association in Arabic, including the LLC's object clause limited to manufacturing of autonomous crop-spraying unmanned aerial vehicles, share capital, management structure, and dispute resolution. Execute before a public notary and secure the notary seal. Then lodge for GAFI online preliminary review.
required_dossiers: List of founding shareholders and share allocation
Draft board resolution appointing initial directors
Power of attorney to local legal representative
Potential member information for AML/KYC screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI issues defect comments, amend the Articles via supplementary notarial deed and resubmit; disputes on interpretation may be raised to GAFI's Administrative Appeal Panel within 15 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Capital Deposit and Escrow Account Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed commercial bank (central bank approved) – Corporate Account Opening Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary escrow corporate account in the LLC's name at a licensed Egyptian bank and deposit at least the portion of capital required by the Articles. The bank issues an escrow certificate evidencing paid-up capital. After incorporation, the escrow converts to the permanent current operating account.
required_dossiers: Passport copies and tax ID numbers of shareholders
Initial capital deposit wire or cash receipt
Bank KYC and AML declaration forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If bank declines due to insufficient documentation, submit a corrected information package to the bank's compliance division; alternatively select a second licensed bank and notify GAFI to update the escrow reference.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI Incorporation Filing and Commercial Registry Entry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Commercial Registry – Corporate Formation Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized Articles, capital deposit certificate, name approval, and board appointments to GAFI's electronic registrar. Pay the registration, publishing, and commercial registry fees. GAFI issues the incorporation certificate and obtains a commercial registration number, tax card, and import/export number.
required_dossiers: Board resolution appointing directors and registered office
Passports of all shareholders and directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is queried, rectify missing legalization or translation documents within 15 days; if the Articles conflict with mandatory provisions, file an amendment Notarial Deed and resubmit to GAFI Regulator Section.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration and Value Added Tax Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority – Registration and Tax Card Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the legal tax registration using the commercial registration number, issue tax cards for all legal and physical locations, and register for value added tax. Obtain the electronic tax filing credentials for monthly VAT and annual income tax filings.
required_dossiers: Lease agreement or proof of registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax authority requires additional proof of physical premises, present the lease contract and site inspection report; appeal erroneous tax registration within 30 days to the Egyptian Tax Authority Appeals Committee.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Industrial Development Authority (IDA) – Industrial Licensing and Investor Services Center
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Industrial Operating License – Manufacture of Agricultural Drone Sprayer Systems (ISIC 2821)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA) – Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) Review Department
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B – Requires registered preliminary EIA screening and consolidated environmental compliance report; may upgrade to Full EIA if manufacturing capacity exceeds thresholds
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Law No. 4 of 1994 and its executive regulations; wastewater discharge limits per ppm for BOD, COD, and suspended solids; VOC emission ceilings based on per-hour kg of solvent use; hazardous waste handling must follow EEAA permit conditions and National Waste Management Law No. 202 of 2020

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from Egyptian Civil Defense Authority supporting factory readiness; structural load inspection certificate from engineer of record; Ministry of Manpower workplace clearance for worker safety, emergency exits, and equipment guarding; final block inspection by the IDA for fit-for-drone-manufacturing operation.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: The Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), operating under the Egyptian Ministry of Finance and governed by the Unified Tax Law No. 30 of 2023 (consolidating income tax rules formerly under Law No. 91 of 2005) and by Value Added Tax Law No. 67 of 2016, as amended by Law No. 3 of 2023. The ETA integrated self-service portal (https://eta.gov.eg) provides TIN onboarding, corporate income tax registration, VAT registration and filing, e-invoicing and e-receipts clearance, and export VAT refund workflows. Entities located in the Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE) or other General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) free zones interface additionally with GAFI for zone licensing and annual facility-fee administration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign-owned Egyptian LLC manufacturing agricultural drone sprayers, the statutory procurement sequence is: (1) incorporate the LLC with GAFI or the SCZONE authority and obtain the commercial registration certificate (qayd tijari) from the Commercial Registry; (2) file a tax card (al-bitaqa al-daribiyya) application through the ETA e-services portal, submitting the articles of association, commercial registration extract, board resolution appointing a resident tax representative (mumathil dharibi), registered-office title or lease, and proof of identity for all non-resident shareholders; (3) receive the unified Tax Identification Number (TIN) and the VAT registration certificate from the ETA, which are issued through the same onboarding workflow; (4) complete simultaneous registration on the ETA e-invoicing platform and with the Egyptian Customs Authority on the Advanced Cargo Information (ACI) system as an exporting operator; (5) undergo ETA technical inspection or Large Taxpayer Office assignment where projected export turnover exceeds the large-taxpayer threshold. Standard issuance takes approximately 5 to 10 business days for the TIN and tax card, and the tax card must be kept aligned with the commercial registration renewal cycle and any change in shareholders or registered address.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — the Egyptian LLC is a tax-resident incorporated entity taxed at the entity level on worldwide income under the Unified Tax Law No. 30 of 2023 (headline corporate rate 22.5%, with small-business progressive brackets in limited cases). Where the LLC holds a GAFI or SCZONE free-zone license with an export-only mandate, a Tax_Exempt_Zone variant applies, substituting corporate income tax with an annual facility charge of generally 1% to 3% of export-derived sales value; VAT zero-rating on outward supplies continues to operate separately. Egyptian LLCs are not eligible for pass-through or partnership look-through classification.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Egypt does not provide a US-style check-the-box election. The Unified Tax Law No. 30 of 2023 contains limited statutory elections: (i) family companies, being entities whose capital is held exclusively by natural persons from a single family, may elect to be taxed as tax-transparent partnerships with income imputed to the individual family members rather than taxed at the entity level; (ii) companies licensed in free zones may elect between the Public Free Zone regime, replacing income tax with the 1% to 3% annual facility charge on gross export sales, or the Private Free Zone regime, preserving standard entity-level taxation while enjoying customs duty relief and input VAT exemptions; and (iii) registered exporters may elect the small-business turnover-based presumptive tax bracket where statutorily eligible. Hybrid-mismatch entity elections are not recognized under Egyptian tax law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under Law No. 67 of 2016, as amended by Law No. 3 of 2023, supplemented by selective excise or table-tax schedules on specified goods and by documentary stamp duties applicable to customs declarations and banking transactions.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory VAT registration applies where the person's annual taxable turnover of goods or services exceeds EGP 500,000 within the preceding 12 months (Article 16 of VAT Law No. 67 of 2016). An export-only LLC producing agricultural drone sprayers must register for VAT regardless of turnover in order to claim input VAT credits and periodic refunds on export zero-rated sales. Registration of non-resident suppliers carrying on economic activity in Egypt through an actual or deemed establishment is likewise required. Customs-side ACI operator registration is administratively separate from the VAT registration threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time fiscal clearance: every tax invoice must be transmitted in XML or JSON to the ETA e-invoicing platform through a certified REST API gateway, authenticated with public-key infrastructure digital certificates, validated against ETA fiscal business rules, and stamped with a Unique Identification Code (UUID) and a cryptographic QR code before the invoice may be issued to the customer. E-receipts are additionally mandated for B2C cash register transactions under the phased e-receipt program. Input VAT is legally recoverable only when the related e-invoice has received ETA fiscal clearance. Penalties for issuing invoices without clearance start per-invoice and escalate up to EGP 50,000 per document in repeat cases, with risk of VAT certificate revocation and criminal referral for forged clearance codes. Export invoices relating to agricultural drone shipments must appear in the monthly e-invoice stream and be reconciled with the official customs export declaration during VAT refund review.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating of exported agricultural drone sprayer units, spare parts, and related hardware applies under Articles 12 and 13 of VAT Law No. 67 of 2016 and its Executive Regulations where: (i) the goods physically depart Egyptian customs territory supported by a customs-approved export declaration; (ii) the buyer is a non-resident person and the invoiced consideration is receivable in convertible foreign currency through the Egyptian banking system; and (iii) the prescribed export documentation bundle is maintained in auditable form. Offshore services, including drone calibration, remote agronomy analytics, and route-planning software supplied to a recipient outside Egypt, may also qualify for zero-rating where the service benefit is realized outside Egypt. In all cases, the LLC must hold the valid export authorization for dual-use UAV technology issued by the competent Egyptian defense trade-control authorities, otherwise the zero-rating claim fails at the completeness review stage. Zero-rated supplies are declared on the monthly VAT return, preserve input VAT recovery on imported components, and any residual credit is refundable under the ETA refund mechanism.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Single Administrative Document, SAD/Form 41) referencing the ACI export pre-declaration number issued by the Egyptian Customs Authority
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, or Truck Waybill endorsing the shipment to the non-resident buyer or the buyer's nominated bank
Inward Foreign-Currency Remittance Certificate (bank call notice or tanfiz receipt) evidencing that the USD or EUR sale proceeds were credited to the LLC's Egyptian bank account
Commercial invoice and the duly executed export sales contract with the non-resident purchaser, including INCOTERMS, UAV technical specifications, and spare-parts schedule
Certificate of Origin issued by the competent Egyptian chamber of commerce or industrial registration authority
Export authorization for agricultural UAV products issued by the competent Egyptian security or defense trade-control authorities
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating refund packages are jointly reviewed by the ETA Large Taxpayer Audit Directorate and the Customs Export Reconciliation Unit; red flags include related-party sales, artificial intermediation, recycled components, inflated invoice values, and foreign proceeds retained offshore beyond the repatriation deadline. Legal consequences for fraudulent zero-rating or falsified export documentation include: (i) under Article 69 of VAT Law No. 67 of 2016, premeditated tax evasion is punishable by imprisonment for up to 5 years and a fine of not less than double the amount of tax evaded; (ii) retrospective clawback of all input VAT credits and refunds, compounded by monthly delay interest of 2% on VAT arrears and an additional administrative penalty of up to 100% of the disallowed amount; (iii) suspension or revocation of the tax card and customs clearance privileges; (iv) public listing on the ETA non-compliance register; and (v) referral to the Tax Prosecutor under the Unified Tax Law No. 30 of 2023. The tax prescription period for proven evasive zero-rating extends to 6 years from the end of the relevant tax period.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt operates a market-determined floating EGP regime since 6 March 2024 under Law No. 194 of 2020. Current-account transactions (goods, services, royalties, dividends) are freely convertible via CBE-licensed banks at interbank rates without prior approval. Capital-account flows are permitted but require GAFI/CBE registration of the inbound investment, an inward-investment certificate from the receiving bank, and Egyptian Tax Authority clearance for outbound profit remittance. Dividend repatriation is subject to a 10% statutory withholding (or treaty-reduced rate upon filing a beneficial-ownership certificate); practical friction arises from USD interbank liquidity and documentary verification of the funded capital, not from statutory quotas.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Law No. 155 of 2023 abolished the former mandatory repatriation-and-surrender regime under Law No. 118 of 1975. Statutory timeline: no fixed conversion deadline; export receipts may remain in the exporter's onshore foreign-currency account or in a licensed offshore account, subject to a 5-year CBE balance-of-payments reporting horizon. Mandatory conversion ratio: 0% — the EG_LLC retains 100% of USD/EUR receipts and may deploy them directly for import payables, loan servicing, reinvestment or dividends. Compliance requires a NAFEZA export declaration, GOEIC export-register card, commercial invoice, bill of lading/AWB, and CBE bank acknowledgment for statistical registration.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules_note: The statutory export-obligation window remains a commercial matter of the underlying contract (typically 180 days from shipment) for collection, but no CBE-imposed surrender or conversion ratio applies after Law No. 155 of 2023.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.capital_account_movement_constraints: Non-resident capital injection must be registered with the CBE through a licensed bank and evidenced by a SWIFT MT103/202 carrying the direct-investment code; unregistered equity cannot be lawfully repatriated later. Shareholder loans require a formal facility agreement and CBE external-debt registration to support both interest deductibility and outbound servicing.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.mandatory_cbe_permissions_and_reporting: Annual and transactional BoP reporting through the account-holding bank; any EGP conversion above EGP 200,000 per month per economic unit is subject to bank source-of-funds verification and CBE liquidity-management oversight.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_timeline_for_collection: No CBE statutory collection deadline; contractual terms control. Former 6-month surrender window repealed by Law No. 155 of 2023.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.dual_use_export_license_interaction: Drone exports must also satisfy the Egyptian Civil Aviation UAS permit and the General Organization for Export and Import Control (GOEIC) licensing regime before export receipts are bank-validated.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (EGP) + Foreign Currency Account (USD/EUR)
Operational Account (EGP) + Foreign Currency Account (USD/EUR) + Trade-Finance Facility
Cross-Border Operational Account (EGP + USD) with correspondent banking

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: LOW. Egypt's Law No. 194 of 2020 reserves foreign-exchange, documentary collections, and trade settlements to CBE-licensed banks. Offshore EMIs (Wise, Currencycloud, Airwallex-type) are not recognised settlement counterparties; wires carrying a non-bank BIC are rejected or escalated to enhanced due diligence. Such rails are acceptable only for immaterial operating expenses (software, travel), never for export collections, LC settlement, or ECGF-guaranteed transactions. All treasury clearing must be bank-to-bank via SWIFT.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physically present onboarding is effectively compulsory. CBE's digital-KYC relaxation covers only low-value consumer e-wallets; corporate accounts classified High_Risk_Special_License require (i) in-person appearance of the managing director and all statutory directors or UBOs, (ii) a compliance interview with the bank's appointed AML officer, (iii) a site-visit audit of the drone assembly and testing facility confirming civilian agricultural spraying use, and (iv) notarised originals of the LLC deed, commercial registry extract, tax card, and all operating licences. Remote-only account opening is not available for a newly incorporated EG_LLC.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Dual-use / military-adjacent product classification — unmanned aerial vehicle under ISIC 2821
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: CBE/GOEIC civilian-product classification letter, AOI (Arab Organization for Industrialization) non-objection, Egyptian Civil Aviation UAS permit under Law No. 8 of 2020, end-user undertakings, and commercial catalogues and engineering data demonstrating spray-only mission configuration and ISIC 2821 agricultural applicability.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High_Risk_Special_License — statutory drone export licence and manufacturing approval required
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid GOEIC Import/Export Register Card, Ministry of Trade and Industry industrial licence, Egyptian Civil Aviation Authority UAS operator/import approval, export permit and packing list for each shipment, CBE export-acknowledgement forms, and a GPS-based end-user certificate for agricultural parcels.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident ownership / foreign direct investment scrutiny and UBO opacity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: GAFI investment certificate, notarised LLC deed under Law No. 159 of 1981, commercial registry extract with complete UBO chain (shareholders holding 10% or more), valid passports/national IDs of all UBOs, source-of-funds statements, bank references from the foreign parent, and audited opening balance sheet if capital is contributed in kind.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions / correspondent-bank cross-border screening (MENA and African distributor networks)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full third-party KYC pack for every downstream distributor, contractual commercial purpose letters, end-user certificates, UN/OFAC/EU sanctions-screening clearance report, and a written representation that the drones are not destined for military end-users or embargoed jurisdictions.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.onboarding_time_estimate_and_facilitator: Realistic onboarding for this file: 8-12 weeks. Preparation of the evidentiary dossier reduces friction; engagement of a licensed corporate service provider and a Cairo-based KYC/AML advisor is recommended before submission to the chosen Tier-1 bank.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Foreign equity enters exclusively via a CBE-licensed bank. The remitter must be the shareholder of record; SWIFT MT103/202 must carry remittance code 'Direct Investment — Equity Contribution' (CBE BoP code 3285) and reference the EG_LLC commercial-register number and GAFI dossier. The receiving bank credits the FCY account and issues an inward-investment certificate (CBE Form-II) anchoring capital registration, future repatriation, and tax basis. Conversion to EGP is executed at the daily interbank rate. Shareholder loans must be supported by a notarised facility agreement and CBE external-debt registration to permit interest capitalisation and outbound servicing. Crypto, digital-wallet, or third-party funding routes are prohibited.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade payables are settled via (i) SWIFT MT103/MT202 T/T against verified commercial invoices, packing lists, and customs declarations, with the 'General Trade' BoP purpose code; (ii) irrevocable documentary Letters of Credit under UCP600 for drone-component imports (e.g., China/Taiwan), issued by the Egyptian account bank and advised through a nominated correspondent bank; (iii) EGP domestic supplier payments via the Egyptian RTGS (Bills Presentation & Transfer System) and CBE instant-payment rails; and (iv) USD outbound wires cleared through the correspondent/nostro network, each carrying the underlying import licence or contract reference for CBE verification.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable EGP/USD FX forward contract, tenor up to 12 months, executed with a CBE-licensed onshore bank, requiring documented underlying commercial exposure (export LC, import PO, or forecast invoice); speculative cover is expressly disallowed by CBE.
EGP/USD FX swap (simultaneous spot sale and forward repurchase, or reverse) for temporary liquidity conversion and working-capital optimisation within a single trade cycle.
USD/EUR cross-currency swap arranged through the bank's international/interbranch desk to match dual-currency component procurement or foreign-currency debt service.

Offshore USD/EGP non-deliverable forward (NDF) referencing the observable CBE interbank rate, permitted solely for hedging genuine export/import exposure, with settlement in USD outside Egypt and no onshore EGP delivery.
FX forward roll-over products and structured trade hedges embedded in letter-of-credit facilities, provided the bank validates the commercial exposure documentation at each rollover date.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.liquidity_clearing_rails_summary: Primary rails: SWIFT MT103/MT202 for wire transfer and SWIFT-advised UCP600 documentary letters of credit for trade settlement. Domestic EGP flows use the CBE RTGS and instant payments. All FCY activity must be traced to bona fide trade or investment documents; no netting, no nostro pooling outside the licensed bank, and no crypto-rail settlement.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.bank_facilities_recommendation: Apply simultaneously for: (i) an import/export documentary credit line, (ii) an EGP overdraft against export proceeds, (iii) an FCY current account with free conversion privileges, and (iv) a hedging line for forward/swap transactions. CIB and NBE offer the deepest LC capacity and correspondent networks for African and Asian markets.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.export_collection_protocol: All export collections must pass through the Egyptian exporter's licensed bank with a NAFEZA declaration, GOEIC card, commercial invoice, and transport document; proceeds may be retained offshore and do not require conversion, but must be reported for CBE BoP registration within the 5-year window.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.regulatory_reference_framework: CBE Law No. 194 of 2020; Law No. 155 of 2023; Law No. 159 of 1981; Law No. 72 of 2017 (GAFI); Law No. 80 of 2002 (AML/CFT); UCP600; SWIFT MT103/MT202/MT700 standards.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.strategic_treasury_structure: Maintain dual banking relationships (one state-owned anchor bank for LC/trade, one private bank for operational FX conversion) to ensure continuity of clearing rails and competitive interbank pricing during USD liquidity tightness.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Form No. 10)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 1 April following the close of the fiscal year (31 December)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 5% of unpaid tax for each month of delay, up to 20%; interest at the ETA announced rate; continued non-filing can trigger enforced collection and administrative strike-off of the LLC.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days of the end of the fiscal year (by 31 March)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to EGP 2,500 per delayed filing; persistent failure can lead to administrative freeze, denial of tax clearance and strike-off proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Justice, Commercial Registry Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On the anniversary date of the original commercial registration certificate, renewed annually
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal surcharge of EGP 500 for each month or part thereof; prolonged non-renewal may lead to deregistration and administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by the expiry date of the current tax card
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal penalty of EGP 100 to 500; inability to present a valid tax card blocks public tenders, customs clearance and banking transactions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation (UBO Register Update)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment (GAFI) Online Portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the Annual General Meeting, but no later than 90 days after fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to EGP 1,000 per day of non-compliance, suspension of corporate filings, and potential criminal liability for directors under Egyptian AML provisions.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent statutory audit is mandatory for Egyptian LLCs meeting any two of the following thresholds in consecutive years: total assets above EGP 25,000,000, annual turnover above EGP 50,000,000, or average workforce above 50 employees; additionally, all LLCs exporting products or holding special licenses (including autonomous aerial spraying equipment) must obtain an auditor-certified audit for annual tax filings and GAFI reporting.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS) issued by Ministry of Finance Decree 110/2015 and adopted under Law No. 159/1981; EAS is substantially converged with IFRS. Listed and regulated entities are required to apply IFRS as endorsed by Egyptian Financial Regulatory Authority.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Each year, the LLC must submit a Beneficial Ownership Declaration Form (Form UBO-1) through the GAFI portal, identifying every individual directly or indirectly holding more than 25% ownership or exercising ultimate control. Any share transfer during the year that causes a change in the UBO register must be reflected and confirmed in the annual filing, supported by a notarized transfer resolution and updated share transfer ledger.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 22.5% standard corporate income tax rate on net taxable profits under Article 51 of Law No. 91 of 2005, as amended (banks and Suez Canal/oil categories taxed at 40%-45%; not applicable to an industrial LLC).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Investment Law No. 72 of 2017: a 50% reduction of the tax due for five consecutive tax years for first-time investments in designated sectors (Category B includes manufacturing of agricultural equipment and machinery); Free Zone status: full exemption of profits for up to 10 years (renewable) for export-oriented drone factories, with tax accounting on exit; small business regime: annual tax at 0.5% of gross receipts for the first three years for taxpayers with annual turnover up to EGP 20 million; accelerated depreciation for production assets.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form No. 16 (Corporate Income Tax Return) filed electronically through the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) e-services portal (www.eta.gov.eg) using the effective tax credentials issued to an Egyptian LLC; the return must be signed by a licensed ETA-mandated accountant for large taxpayers.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; corporate prepayments are due quarterly on the basis of the prior year's tax liability.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual CIT return due within four months after the close of the fiscal year (Article 60, Law No. 91 of 2005). For a calendar-year LLC, the deadline is 30 April of the following year. A PE of a non-resident uses the same rule. Extension is available only through approved tax advisors with the ETA's acceptance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: LLC legal name, commercial registration No., tax card No., head office address in Egypt, fiscal year-end, activity classification (ISIC 2821 - Manufacture of agricultural drone sprayers).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Same declaration for a fixed place of business (PE) of the foreign shareholder; otherwise answer the registry question that no Egyptian PE exists.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross sales revenue including export proceeds (LC/TT), returns, discounts; revenue is converted to EGP at the Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) exchange rate on the invoice date.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Export revenue attributable to PE activities must be disclosed; non-resident without PE leaves this line blank.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box B - Cost of Sales and Deductible Expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Documented purchases, subcontracted drone component costs, employee compensation, depreciation, direct overhead, finance charges (subject to capitalisation rules).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Expenses of the Egyptian PE only; head-office general and administrative charges are allowed only if supported by an allocation statement and capped under the arm's-length TP rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Controlled transactions with parent and affiliates (e.g., sale of drones to foreign distributor, purchase of flight-control software, intercompany loans); a TP Disclosure Form must be attached when the aggregate value exceeds EGP 1 million.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign-related-party transactions attributable to the Egyptian PE are likewise disclosed; failure to attach the form suspends the submission.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Loss carry-forward from the preceding five tax years offset against current-year taxable income, capped by the statutory rules and subject to ownership continuity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses of a non-resident PE may be offset only against subsequent Egyptian PE income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box E - Taxable Income and Tax Due
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after all adjustments multiplied by 22.5%; investment incentives (50% five-year deduction) and any free-zone exemption applied.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident PE income taxed at 22.5% on Egyptian-source net profit; no branch remittance withholding for an Egyptian LLC (LLC dividends are instead taxed when distributed).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box F - Tax Credits and Prepayments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Withholding tax credits (e.g., CBE interest withholding), quarterly advance payments already remitted, foreign tax credit available under an applicable DTA or Law No. 91 of 2005 Articles 34-35.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign tax credit claimed must be evidenced by a TRC; dividend WHT imposed on the Egyptian LLC at 10% may be reduced if the foreign shareholder provides treaty relief papers.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box G - Final Tax Payable or Refund
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Difference between tax due and prepayments/credits; final liability settled through the ETA e-filing portal; refund request filed if overpaid.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents authorise an Egyptian representative for refund status; ETA may set off the refund against any unremitted dividend WHT.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file on time: a surcharge of 5% of the total tax due for each month or fraction of a month of delay, capped at 25% of the tax (Article 136, Law 91/2005). Failure to pay on time: monthly interest at 1% of the unpaid tax (Article 137), now harmonised with the CBE discount rate plus 2% under the Unified Tax Procedures Law No. 30 of 2023. Filing false data carries fines ranging from EGP 5,000 to EGP 20,000 in addition to criminal penalties.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on cash dividends and other profit distributions paid by an Egyptian LLC to resident and non-resident shareholders (Article 55, Law 91/2005 as amended by Law 64 of 2015).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke a reduced treaty rate (typically 5%-10%), the non-resident shareholder must (i) obtain a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from its state of residence valid for the distribution year, (ii) provide a certified Arabic translation and an original/notarised copy to the Egyptian LLC, and (iii) file the treaty relief application with the ETA before the distribution is made; the LLC must retain the TRC as the legal basis for withholding at the reduced rate. If over-withheld, the shareholder files a WHT refund claim within the statutory assessment window (up to six years) with supporting evidence of beneficial ownership.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: 20% WHT on royalties paid to non-residents for IP (including drone control software and agricultural sensor know-how) and 20% WHT on interest paid to non-resident lenders (Law 91/2005, Articles 55-56). Treaty relief normally reduces both to 10%-15%, e.g., under the Egypt-UK, Egypt-Germany and other OECD-based DTAs, subject to TRC and beneficial-ownership documentation. Payments for management and technical services rendered to the LLC attract the same 20% WHT.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EGP 1 million: mandatory annual TP Disclosure Form to accompany the CIT return when the aggregate of controlled transactions in a tax category exceeds this amount. EGP 10 million: aggregate related-party transactions trigger the preparation of Local File and Master File in line with the ETA Transfer Pricing Guidelines (Presidential Decree No. 467 of 2018). MNE groups with consolidated group revenue above EGP 22 billion (approx. EUR 750 million) must file a Country-by-Country Report; all documentation must be in Arabic/English and retained for six years.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt does not administer a UAE-style Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) filing, but the ETA applies a broad substance-over-form and GAAR doctrine (Article 43, Law 91/2005; Article 5 of Law 30/2023). An Egyptian LLC is automatically tax-resident by incorporation; the use of offshore board meetings, nominee shareholders or an accommodation office does not defeat Egyptian source taxation. The Free Zone regime requires a fixed registered premises, Egyptian employees, real local activity and an audited account trail for the 10-year exemption; a shell holding or letterbox distribution company exporting drones through Egypt will be treated as fictitious and the profits re-attributed to the foreign beneficial owner, without the free-zone benefit.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and False Commercial Documentation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate under-declaration of drone export proceeds, use of un-invoiced cash sales, creation of fake purchase invoices for drone components, over-invoicing imports, or concealment of books and records with intent to evade the 22.5% corporate tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imprisonment for three to five years and a fine of EGP 10,000 to EGP 50,000 (Article 143, Law 91/2005); payment of the evaded tax in full plus monthly interest of 1% (up to a cumulative additional levy of 100% of the evaded tax); seizure of movable and immovable assets; cancellation of the tax card and e-invoicing registration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The general manager, executive directors and authorised signatories are jointly and severally liable for the company's tax debt; the ETA may obtain a preventive travel ban and asset-freeze order against each responsible person; criminal conviction results in disqualification from board membership and potential custodial sentences.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Sham Arrangement Without Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: An Egyptian LLC operating with no physical office, no actual employees in Egypt, no Egyptian bank account, or functioning purely as an invoice conduit for a foreign drone principal; the company has no business purpose other than obtaining incentive status or treaty relief.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax administration disregards the corporate entity, re-characterises the transactions, and assesses tax on the beneficial owner at 22.5% on the deemed Egyptian-source profit, with surcharges up to 100% of the tax and penalties for late filing; free-zone tax holidays are revoked and export incentives clawed back; the trade register and tax licence may be struck off.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors are personally liable for the unpaid corporation tax and penalties on a civil basis; they may be criminally prosecuted for falsifying corporate records and for aiding tax evasion; travel bans and a prohibition from holding any Egyptian corporate directorship follow a conviction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to attach the TP Disclosure Form at the EGP 1 million threshold, refusal to prepare Local/Master File at the EGP 10 million level, charging non-arm's-length markups to a foreign distributor of agricultural drones, or failing to benchmark intercompany software royalties and management fees.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The ETA reassesses the related-party transactions under the arm's-length principle, upward-adjusts the taxable income, and applies the 22.5% rate on the difference; the assessment window extends six years; monthly interest of 1% accrues on the deficiency; non-compliance in repeat audits can trigger anti-evasion fines of up to EGP 20,000 per false declaration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors approving transfer prices without a benchmark report are jointly and severally liable for the primary tax adjustment; involvement in falsified documentation lifts the corporate veil and leads to civil restitution, an ETA travel ban and criminal prosecution for tax fraud in aggravated cases.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving drone export proceeds in undeclared cash, failing to repatriate export receivables into Egypt within the CBE's 30-day window, executing transactions above EGP 250,000 in cash without AML disclosure, or maintaining unknown/beneficial-owner opacity in the LLC's shareholder structure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalties under AML Law No. 80 of 2002 reach imprisonment of up to 15 years and fines of up to EGP 1 million; the EMLCU may freeze the company's bank accounts and the CBE may blacklist the exporter and suspend its import/export registry, depriving the drone manufacturer of foreign currency allocations and expunging export incentives.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Shareholders and directors face personal criminal liability, custodial sentences, mandatory restitution of the undeclared foreign currency and civil fines; the Ministry of Justice may issue a travel ban and prevent the responsible persons from managing financial entities in Egypt.
